summary: John's maternal 2nd great-grandfather; San Mango d'Aquino emigrant to Scranton's Providence section, father of Helen (Ferlaino) Cognetti.
bio: Tree: Leopoldo Ferlaino (1871-1915) + Giuseppina Fiorillo (1871-1943), parents of Helen. Round 1 found no public record naming him or his wife and could not establish where he died in 1915 (Scranton or San Mango); the Diamond Avenue Ferlaino household was a speculative candidate for their home. Round 2: his widow headed 1306 Diamond Ave in 1920; his PA-born children Frank (c.1902-03) and Raffaela (c.1904-05) show he was in Scranton by about 1901. Helen's fifth son Leopold Salvatore was apparently named for him. San Mango cemetery index has no Leopoldo or Giuseppina, consistent with both dying in Scranton. No published FS profile under Ferlaino, Farino, Farina or Fiorillo with a Scranton tie. Antenati's San Mango coverage ends in 1860, so his 1871 birth and the Ferlaino x Fiorillo marriage (c.1890-95) cannot be reached there. Ferlaino is genuinely a San Mango family: the stati delle anime 1674-1804 have 229 Ferlaino entries (e.g. Francesco Ferlaino and Fragostina Colosimo with children Carmine, Giuseppe Antonio and others, 1771-88); a mid-1990s phone directory shows Ferlaino x24.
